title: INTF-CLI socket resume verb (INV-LIFE-2, Task 3.9): the pause counterpart — a caller that already holds a connection to a running core resumes one of the two named gates without ever causing a core to start (ADR 0036). Omitting `gate` defaults to quota_paused, the same default cmd/pr-pool's file-direct `resume [<gate>]` subcommand uses.
